biggest_catch: This is a BUSINESS account — you need a real business with an EIN (or qualifying sole proprietorship), business documentation, and in many cases an in-branch visit. Anyone without a business cannot earn this bonus at all.
catches: Requires a business: EIN required (single-member LLCs may use SSN/ITIN); LLCs need articles of organization; sole proprietors need a business license or DBA filing.
'Earn up to $500' is tiered — the full $500 requires the top new-money deposit tier within 30 days of enrollment; smaller deposits earn less.
Must complete 5 qualifying transactions (debit purchases, QuickDeposit, ACH credits, wires, bill pay, QuickAccept) within 90 days of enrollment.
Offer expires 10/15/2026 — after that date the terms must be re-verified.
$15 monthly service fee (waivable, e.g., $2,000 minimum balance).
New Chase business checking customers only; one bonus per account.

steps: Go to the official Chase business offer page https://account.chase.com/business/business-checking-offer and confirm the offer is live (currently expires 10/15/2026) and note the deposit tier needed for the full $500.
Gather business documentation: EIN (or SSN for single-member LLC), articles of organization or business license/DBA, and two forms of personal ID.
Open a new Chase Business Complete Checking account through the offer page (online or in branch) and enroll in the bonus.
Within 30 days of enrollment, deposit the new-money amount for your target tier and maintain that balance for 60 days.
Within 90 days of enrollment, complete 5 qualifying transactions: debit card purchases, Chase QuickDeposit, ACH credits, wires, bill pay, or QuickAccept.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the bonus is deposited within 15 days after all requirements are complete.
To avoid the $15 monthly fee, keep a $2,000 minimum balance or meet another fee waiver.
timing: Bonus deposited within 15 days after completing all requirements.
